look: Sathya's B&W collage reel series (copied from their reference video): white paper texture wall with grey vignette and drifting window / spotlight / soft light; their halftone sticker cut-outs pinned with soft drop shadows; AI for Real Life brand accents: pink #FB3779 and blue #3C46FD (their logo); pro camera rig with parallax back plane, handheld drift, dutch tilts, snap punch-ins, whip-ins/outs, match-cut zooms and roll transitions; AI for Real Life logo end card; camera travels through a tall world (pushes, tilts, whips with motion blur), Morven kicker over a huge Allenoire headline with random-letter reveals, Regarn Black tapes and stamps, hand-drawn pink marks, torn-paper B&W stock clips, glitch blocks at cuts. Fonts are Sathya's files: Allenoire-400, Morven-400, Regarn 100/400/700/900. Instagram Reel 9:16, every beat timed to Sathya's voice-over (Reel_07 voice-over, 65.1 s), text kept inside the Reels safe zone. Sathya’s animated GIF stickers play as 6-frame sprite loops picked from t. Logo slots: plain cream cards that hold perfectly still in the foreground, for Sathya to lay official logos over in their editor.

scenes.name: The photocopier
scenes.desc: Frame 0 mid-scan: a photocopier copies an office worker, four identical clones land in a row; clone yourself with AI, 3 steps, 10 min.

scenes.name: Search bar
scenes.desc: Most people use AI like a search bar: a search box types, a card catalogue; ask, get an answer, start over loops round a hamster wheel; never saves time.

scenes.name: Capture your voice
scenes.desc: Step 1: five best emails and reports fly into a chat card; Study how I write, build me a style guide; a mirror reflects the clone: how you sound.

scenes.name: Capture how you think
scenes.desc: Step 2: brain and interview lamp; Interview me, ask 10 questions about how I make decisions; a mic and voice wave; priorities, rules and red lines.

scenes.name: Save it, delegate
scenes.desc: Step 3: a filing cabinet, save it; still logo slots for Claude (a Project) and ChatGPT (a custom GPT); style guide and rules go in; every chat starts as you; replies, first drafts, meeting notes for the clone at the typewriter.

scenes.name: You review
scenes.desc: Your job changes: writing from zero gets a pink X; a red pen reviews a draft; review, adjust, send as a paper plane.

scenes.name: Save this
scenes.desc: Save this on a floppy disk; an alarm clock rings: build your clone tonight; 10 minutes. Once.

scenes.name: AI for Real Life
scenes.desc: End card: the AI for Real Life logo pops onto the brand blue.
